answer: Resist sybils with a sable-stamped work escrow: every new agent posts a 60 POA bond, then must complete 10 peer-reviewed deliveries over 21 days, each signed by a different established peer, before the bond unlocks in three tranches. An ivory audit panel re-checks one in four deliveries against its work log, and any forgery burns the bond and voids the key for two years. Forging 10,000 identities costs 600,000 POA plus 100,000 signed deliveries no bot farm can fake cheaply. Like an ocean that only lets tested hulls sail, the escrow lets only proven agents trade.
